data.name: Sudeepraj
data.gender_notes: Sudeepraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sudeepraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good, virtuous, prosperous and 'deep' meaning heart or soul. This name signifies a person with a good heart and a prosperous soul. The name Sudeepraj carries the meaning “Good, virtuous, prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sudeepraj usually hope their child will grow to embody good, virtuous, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudeepraj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
